title: The Koszul-direction differential on a positive-length pure tensor
statement: Let (C,J,O) be a small ringed site with commutative O [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], A a commutative ring, rho:A -> Gamma(O), r,m natural numbers, a:Fin(r+1)->A, K an arbitrary unbounded complex, q an integer, and I a subset of Fin(r+1). Use the actual ordered negative Koszul complex Q of [def-cbc-signed-koszul-completion-model] and the second total differential D2 of K tensor Q [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. The canonical map s_I=ringedNegativeKoszulSummand satisfies s_I D2 = sum over i in I of rho((-1)^(q+|I|) (-1)^|{j in I:j<i}| a_i^(m+1)) times the equality transport K^(q+|I|) -> K^((q+1)+|I.erase i|), followed by s_(I.erase i) in degree q+1. Each term is conditionally zero if this degree equality fails (it holds for i in I). Parity represents the integer-degree sign in A. This statement has neither a coordinate isomorphism nor the first (coefficient-complex) differential contribution.

theorem ringedNegativeKoszulSummand_D₂_succ
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) {A : Type z} [CommRing A]
    (ρ : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (O.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A) (m : ℕ) (K : ringedSiteComplex O) (q : ℤ)
    (I : Finset (Fin (r + 1))) :
    letI : IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O)) :=
      SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian _
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory O
    letI := SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory O
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed O).1
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed O).2.1
    ringedNegativeKoszulSummand O ρ a m K q I ≫
      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.D₂ K
        (ringedNegativeKoszul O (r + 1) (fun i ↦ ⟨(ρ (a i)).val, (ρ (a i)).property⟩) m)
        (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) q (q + 1) =
      ∑ i ∈ I, if h : q + (I.card : ℤ) = (q + 1) + ((I.erase i).card : ℤ) then
        ringedKoszulCoefficientSMul O ρ
          ((if Even (q + (I.card : ℤ)) then (1 : A) else -1) *
            (-1 : A) ^ (I.filter (fun j ↦ j < i)).card * a i ^ (m + 1))
          (K.XIsoOfEq h).hom ≫
            ringedNegativeKoszulSummand O ρ a m K (q + 1) (I.erase i)
      else 0
